var $help = 1 ;Change this to 0 to disable the help from always popping up; there is still the ? button :)

;This is the code for the HUD, the primary code for the craft itself is in the computer.
;Note that the HUD has a bi-directional communication with the craft.
;Currently this is mostly to communicate information to the HUD 
;Importantly; the pressure is communicated to the vessel from this code, enabling automatic reduction
;of flight power without using too many inputs on the computer.

include "parse.xc"

var $prevAlt =0

var $planeinfo = panel(top, 700, 60)
var $helpInfo = panel(top,400,400)
var $nav = panel(center,100,100)
var $instr = panel(bottom,300,60)
var $cps  =50

var $info = 0;
var $kph = 0
var $alt = 0
var $abs = "1"
var $sea =  0
var $altacc = 0
var $mousefly = 0;
var $mouseover = 0;
var $navSize = 100;
var $navsizing = 0;
var $odd = 0;
var $trimoverlays = 1;
var $navoverlay = 1;
var $speedoverlay = 1;
var $altoverlay = 1;

var $beacon = beacon("RCS-500-HUD-RECEIVE","RCS-500-HUD-SEND")  
var $values = ""; //gets set with $beacon.data every tick

function @newDrawInfo($x:number,$y:number,$color:number):text
	var	$bloop =  ""
	$bloop.x = $x
	$bloop.y = $y
	$bloop.color = $color
	return $bloop
	
function @nextLine($drawInfo: text,$panel:panel, $line:text,$time: number,$current: number): text
	var $x = 0 + $drawInfo.x
	var $y = 0 + $drawInfo.y
	var $z = 0 + $drawInfo.color
	if($current == $time ||  $current > $time)
		$panel.write($x,$y,$z,$line)
	$drawInfo.y += 10
	return $drawInfo
	
function @advice() : text
	if $mouseover && !$mousefly
		return "click=mouse fly!"
	if(abs($values.h) > 0.5 )
		return "reduce roll"
	if(abs($values.v) > 0.5 )
		return "reduce pitch"
	if $values.brr
		if $alt < 500
			if($kph < 150)
				return "SPEED UP!"
		else 
			if $alt < 2000 && $kph < 300
				return "low speed.."
		if $alt < 26000
			return "climb"
	else
		if($alt < 3)
			if($values.v > -0.2)
				return	"increase pitch"
			if(abs($values.h) > 0.1)
				return	"reduce roll"
			if($values.brr == 0)
				return "[T] to takeoff."			
	if $values.use < 0
		if $values.bat < 0.5
			return "watch batt!"
		return	"discharging."
	return ""	
	
function @altvalue ($altv: number) : number
	var $max_alt = 350000
	var $a = 0.1		 ; higher 'a' = more low-altitude detail
	var $h = $navsize * 0.5

	; Prevent log(0) issues
	if $alt < 0.01
		$alt = 0.01

	; Log scale normalized
	var $num = log(1 + $a * $altv)
	var $den = log(1 + $a * $max_alt)
	var $norm = $num / $den

	; Invert Y (0 at top, h at bottom)
	return $h * (1 - $norm)
	
function @nav()
	if !$navoverlay
		$nav.blank(color(100,100,300,0))
		return

	if $navsizing && $odd
		var $prevnavsize = $navsize
		$navsize = clamp($navsize*(1 + $navsizing/6) ,50,screen_h*0.8)
		$nav.set_size($navsize,$navsize)
		;$nav.set_size(screen_h*0.8,screen_h*0.8)
		;if($navsizing > 0)
		;	$nav.set_size(screen_h*0.8,screen_h*0.8)
		if($navsize == $prevnavsize)
		;	if($navsizing < 0)
		;		$nav.set_size(50,50)
			$navsizing = 0
		;$nav.blank(color(40,40,200,355))
	else
		$nav.blank(color(100,100,300,10))
		
	;$nav.draw_poly(yellow, 0, 0, 50, 50, 100, 0)
	var	$h_window_start = screen_w/2 - $navsize*0.5;
	var	$h_window_stop = screen_w/2 + $navsize*0.5;
	var	$v_window_start = screen_h/2 - $navsize*0.5;
	var	$v_window_stop = screen_h/2 + $navsize*0.5;
	
	$mouseover = 0
	;print($h_window_start,mouse_x,$h_window_stop)
	if( mouse_x > $h_window_start &&  mouse_x < $h_window_stop)
		if( mouse_y > $v_window_start &&  mouse_y < $v_window_stop)
			$mouseover = 1
			if($mousefly)
				$values.update = 1
				$values.h = (($h_window_start - mouse_x)+$navsize*0.5) /(-$navsize*0.5)
				$values.v = (($v_window_start - mouse_y)+$navsize*0.5) /(-$navsize*0.5)
			;print($values.h)
	var $navcol = if($mousefly,color(0,255,0,255),color(255,0,0,40))
	if $nav.button_rect(0,0,$navsize,$navsize,$navcol)
		$mousefly = if($mousefly,0,1)
		if($mousefly)
			$navsizing = 1;
		else
			$navsizing = -1;
	var $trimx = $navsize*0.5+($values.h*$navsize*0.5)
	var $trimy = $navsize*0.5+($values.v*$navsize*0.5)
	
	if($navsizing == 0) ;Display the main indicator for tirmp/ptiuch,.
		$nav.draw_circle($trimx,$trimy,8,5,color(255,0,0,100))
	$nav.draw_line(0,$navsize*0.5,$navsize,$navsize*0.5,color(255,255,0,100))
	$nav.draw_line($navsize*0.5,0,$navsize*0.5,$navsize,color(0,0,0,100))
	if $mousefly && $trimoverlays
		;Display horizontal roll in degrees, in-axis
		$nav.draw_line($trimx,$navsize*0.5-4,$trimx,$navsize*0.5+4,color(0,255,255,100))
		$nav.write($trimx-25,$navsize*0.5-10, cyan, "" & text(round(($values.h+0)*90)) & "°" )
		;Display vertical pitch in degrees, in-axis
		$nav.draw_line($navsize*0.5-4,$trimy,$navsize*0.5+4,$trimy,color(0,255,255,100))
		$nav.write($navsize*0.5-15,$trimy, cyan, "" & text(-round(($values.v+0)*90)) & "°" )
	if($altoverlay)
		$nav.draw_line($navsize/2-20,@altvalue($alt),$navsize/2+20,@altvalue($alt),color(0,255,255,200))
		;Todo: indicate actual craft rotatation and communicate sensor value from plane to do so.
		$nav.write($navsize/2-15,@altvalue($alt),cyan,"" & text($alt) & "m")
	;speedoverlay not yet implemented.
	

function @planeInfo()
	if($info == 0 )
		$planeinfo.blank(color(100,100,0,0)) 
		return
	;Draw information from plane.
	$planeinfo.blank(color(200,100,100,100))
	$planeinfo.write(1, 1, cyan, "" & $values)			
	$planeinfo.write(1, 20, cyan, "roll: " & $values.h)
	$planeinfo.write(1, 10, cyan, "pitch: " & $values.v)		
	$planeinfo.write(1, 30, cyan, "thrust%: " & text($values.fl*10))
	
function @helpInfo()
	if($help == 0 )
		$helpInfo.blank(color(100,100,0,0))
		return
	$help = $help + 1
	
	$helpInfo.blank(color(10,10,50,180))
	
	var $n = color(10,100,200);
	var $h = color(10,120,255);
	var $di = @newDrawInfo(10,10,color(10,100,200));
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"Close   - Help Instructions - ",0,$help)
	if $helpinfo.button_rect(9,9,40,20,color(0,0,255,255))
		$values.update = 1
		$values.q = "n"
		return 

	$di.y += 10
	$di.color = $h
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"« Flight basics »",1*$cps,$help) 
	$di.color = $n
	
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  Thrust: [Space] or [T] for continuous thrust.",1*$cps+2,$help) 
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  WASD for immediate adjustments resp down/up and roll left/right",1*$cps+4,$help) 
	$di.y += 10
	
	$di.color = color(255,255,0)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"« Mouse-Assisted Flight »",2*$cps,$help)
	$di.color = $n
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  Click the middle of the screen to use mouse-flight.",2*$cps+2,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  This allows fine-tuned control and better information.",2*$cps+4,$help)
	
	$di.color = $h
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"« Advanced Flight »",3*$cps,$help)
	$di.color = $n

	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  Pitch trim: arrows   up/down",3*$cps+4,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  Roll  trim: arrows left/right",3*$cps+8,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  NOTE: roll is horizon-stabilized with a PID.",3*$cps+20,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  you will need to adjust pitch yourself, but can effect a stable",3*$cps+21,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"                                                 cruise altitude.",3*$cps+21,$help)
	
	$di.color = $h
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"« Flight Advice »",8*$cps,$help)
	$di.color = $n
	
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  The HUD shows you your speed. Takeoff requires 150 km/h.",8*$cps+10,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  Air Pressure is communicated ot the craft through this HUD",8*$cps+12,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"",4*$cps+12,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  Flight is most efficient at 26.000 metres+ and can be sustained ",8*$cps+20,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  virtually indefinitely as the solar power meets demands",8*$cps+28,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  when exposed to the sun.",8*$cps+36,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  ",4*$cps,$help)
	
	
	$di.color = color(200,150,20,200)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"« Ground Handling »",10*$cps,$help)
	$di.color = $n
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  Q/E turns the wheel, or uses thruster.",10*$cps+2,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"  Brakes engage if pilot is not in seat.",10*$cps+4,$help)
	
	$di.color = color(200,150,20,200)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"« Advanced »",11*$cps,$help)
	$di.color = $n
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"« Check out the lower panel to toggle features. »",11*$cps,$help)
	
	$di.color = color(255,0,0,255)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"Press the close button to close this help text on the top-left.",12*$cps,$help)
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"Press [ALT] briefly to do this, or Refer to [F1] manual :)",16*$cps,$help)
	$di.y +=20
	$di = @nextLine($di,$helpInfo,"The [?] button in the main Hud is a persistent toggle.",16*$cps,$help)
	return
	


init	
	set_cps($cps) 
	
	;each tick, we read values and then write them back later, possibly modified.
tick
	$odd = if($odd,0,1)
	$values = $beacon.data
	;use the storage of the plane to read whether or not help was wanted.
	if $values.q == "y" && $help == 0
		$help = 1
	else 
		if $values.q == "n"
			$help = 0;

	@planeInfo()
	@helpInfo()
	@nav()
	
;	print($values)
	;read instruments
	$values.p =  @round(@parse(get("avatar_sensor_density"),2)) 
	$values.as  =  @round(@parse(get("avatar_sensor_speed"),2)) 
	$kph = @round($values.as * 3.6,1)
	$alt = @round(@parse(get("avatar_sensor_altitude"),2))-1.6 ;remove 1.6 due to height offset of character.
	$abs = get("avatar_sensor_altitude_absolute")
	$sea =  @parse($abs) - 6203000;
	$altacc = ($sea-$prevAlt) 
	$prevAlt = $sea;
	
	;Draw instruments panel.
	$instr.blank(color(100,100,100,100))
	
	;print($values.as)
	if $values.as
		$instr.write(1, 1, color(0,255,100), "" & @padRight($values.as,6," ") & " m/s (" & text($kph) & "km/h)" )	
		$instr.write(160, 1, color(0,255,100), "" & @padRight(text(round($values.bat*10000)/100),5," ")  & " %bat"  )	
		var $col  = if($values.use > 0,color(0,255,100),color(255,0,100))
		
		$instr.write(160, 12, color(0,255,100), "advice: " & @advice())
		
		$instr.write(220, 1, $col, "(" & @sign($values.use) & text(round($values.use)/1000)  & "kW)"  )	
	if $alt
		$instr.write(1, 10, brown, "ter " & text($alt) & "m")
	$instr.write(1, 20, cyan, "asl " & text(@round($sea,2)) & "m " & text("ø{})",$altacc) )
	
	$instr.write(50,30,color(255,0,0),"reset roll")
	
	;interface
	$instr.write(50,30,color(255,0,0),"reset roll")
	if $instr.button_rect(30,50,40,60,color(200,200,200,200),color(200,0,0,0))
		$values.v = 0
		$values.update = 1
		print("made it :" & $values.h)
	$instr.write(50,50,color(255,0,0),"reset pitch")
	if $instr.button_rect(30,30,40,40,color(200,200,200,200),color(200,0,0,0))
		$values.h = 0
		$values.update = 1
		print("made it :" & $values.h)
		
	$instr.write(292,31,color(0,200,255),"?")
	if $instr.button_rect(290,30,300,40,color(200,200,200,200),color(0,0,0,0))
		$values.update = 1
		$values.q = if($help,"n","y")  
		
	$instr.write(291,50,color(255,0,0),"i")
	if $instr.button_rect(290,50,300,60,color(200,200,200,200),color(200,0,0,0)) ;show raw information
		$info = if($info,0,1)
	
	$instr.write(2,40,color(0,0,255),"+")
	if $instr.button_rect(0,39,11,49,color(200,200,200,200),color(200,0,0,0)) ;increase nav size.
		$navsize = clamp($navsize*1.2,50,screen_h*0.8)
		$nav.set_size($navsize, $navsize)
	$instr.write(13,40,color(0,0,255),"- nav")
	if $instr.button_rect(11,39,21,49,color(200,200,200,200),color(200,0,0,0)) ;reduce nav size
		$navsize = clamp($navsize*0.8,50,screen_h*0.8)
		$nav.set_size($navsize, $navsize)
		
	if $instr.button_rect(23,39,45,49, if($navoverlay,color(70,250,70,200),color(250,70,70,200) )) ;toggle navigation display entirely
		$navoverlay = if($navoverlay,0,1)
		
	$instr.write(52,41,color(0,200,255),"trim overlay")
	if $instr.button_rect(51,40,126,50, if($trimoverlays,color(70,250,70,200),color(250,70,70,200) ) ) ;show trim overlays in angles.
		$trimoverlays = if($trimoverlays,0,1)
		
	$instr.write(131,41,color(0,200,255),"nav speed")
	if $instr.button_rect(130,40,186,50, if($speedoverlay,color(70,250,70,200),color(250,70,70,200) ) ) ;toggle display of speed in nav.
		$speedoverlay = if($speedoverlay>1,0,$speedoverlay+1)
	if($speedoverlay == 1)
		$instr.write(188,41,color(0,200,255),"km/h")
	if($speedoverlay == 2)
		$instr.write(188,41,color(0,200,255),"m/s")
		
	$instr.write(131,51,color(0,200,255),"nav   alt")
	if $instr.button_rect(130,50,186,60, if($altoverlay,color(70,250,70,200),color(250,70,70,200) ) ) ;toggle display of terrain altitude in nav.
		$altoverlay = if($altoverlay,0,1)
	
	;must be the last line to be able to change anything.	
	$beacon.transmit($values)

function @round($value : number, $decimals : number) : number
	var $factor = pow(10, $decimals)
	return round($value * $factor) / $factor
	
function @padRight($text : text, $length : number, $char : text) : text
	var $result = $text
	while size($result) < $length
		$result &= $char
	return $result
	
function @padLeft($text : text, $length : number, $char : text) : text
	var $result = ""
	while size($result) + size($text) < $length
		$result &= $char
	$result &= $text
	return $result

function @findDotOrLastIndex($text : text) : number
	var $index = find($text, ".")
	if $index == -1
		$index = size($text)  ; If no dot, set to size of the text (past the last digit)
	return $index
	
function @sign($number: number) : text
	if $number > 0
		return "+"
	return ""
	

function @isDigit($char : text) : number
	if find("0123456789", $char) != -1
		return 1
	return 0

function @parse($text : text) : number
	var $dotIndex = @findDotOrLastIndex($text)
	var $result = 0
	var $foundNumbers = 0
	var $currentChar = ""
	var $currentDigit = 0
	var $i = 0
	var $length = size($text)

	; Process digits before the dot
	while $i < $dotIndex
		$currentChar = $text.$i
		if @isDigit($currentChar)
			$currentDigit = $currentChar:number
			$result += $currentDigit * pow(10, $dotIndex - $i - 1)
			$foundNumbers++
		$i++

	; Process digits after the dot
	$i = $dotIndex + 1
	while $i < $length
		$currentChar = $text.$i
		if @isDigit($currentChar)
			$currentDigit = $currentChar:number
			$result += $currentDigit * pow(10, -($i - $dotIndex))
			$foundNumbers++
		$i++

	if $foundNumbers == 0
		return 0
	return $result

storage var $t:number ;thrust
storage var $h:number ;roll
storage var $v:number ;pitch
storage var $q:text ; whether or not helptext should show.

var $in = ""
var $out = ""

;Read and write from the beacon; executed from the nodes.
function @read()
	$in = input_text(8,0)
	$t = $in.p*1 ;desired thrust is based on presusure, read from player.
	;print("in h:" & $in.h)
	
	;If we're receiving an update from the HUD, we must take a copy.
	;If we don't do this and push back our values and take ownership,
	;the consequence is a race-condition due to unsynchronizable send/receive loops.
	;I don't know a way around this, so I consider it a technical limitation of the game
	;at tihs point in time (june 2025)
	if($in.update)
		print("updated values.")
		$q = $in.q
		$h = $in.h
		$v = $in.v
		$in.update = 0;
	
	return
	
function @write()
	$in.q = $q
	$in.h = $h
	$in.v = $v
	output_text(8,0,$in)
	;print("out  h:" & $in.h)
	return

include "maincontrols.main.xc"
